programs.name: suaddstatics
programs.purpose: Assign random surface-consistent source and receiver statics to trace headers.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUADDSTATICS - ADD random STATICS on seismic data

params.name: shift
params.description: Maximum magnitude of each random component; the code reports the missing value as a time shift in seconds, while the selfdoc says milliseconds.

params.name: dt
params.default: computed: first trace header dt divided by 1000.0 when parameter is zero or absent

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Random values use franuni and mixed float/double arithmetic before rounding into the short tstat header. The program assumes the supplied CMP count and fold bounds match the input; unused fold entries can be uninitialized.
programs.difficulty_reason: It buffers an entire CMP-sorted dataset and builds source and receiver mappings.

programs.name: sufarldcsv
programs.purpose: Compute a smoothed floating datum from source and receiver statics in Q-files.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUFARLDCSV - Floating Approximate Robust Local Datum From Q-files.
programs.float_sensitive_notes: The complete parameter inventory, indirect grid parameters, library calls, and executable test cases have not been verified. The program explicitly requires stdin and stdout to be terminals.
programs.difficulty_reason: It combines grid handling, spatial searches, edge compensation, averaging, and smoothing in more than 1500 lines.

programs.name: sugetqcsv
programs.purpose: Write selected trace headers and samples to a Q-file.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUGETQCSV - Write Trace Header Key Values and Sample Values to a Q-file

params.name: keys
params.description: Trace-header or supported derived key names.

params.name: lsamp
params.description: Last sample index; -1 disables sample output.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Formatting depends on C printf; coordinate scaling uses floating-point arithmetic. The code allocates format strings without space for their terminating null byte and permits lsamp equal to tr.ns, causing out-of-bounds access.
programs.difficulty_reason: It extracts and formats headers and samples one trace at a time.

test_cases.description: Write selected headers and samples to a Q-file.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 | sugetqcsv keys=cdp,sx,gx fsamp=0 lsamp=7 qout=qhed.csv

test_cases.description: Write derived midpoint coordinates with an explicit format.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 | sugetqcsv keys=cdp,mx,my formxy=%.6g qout=midpoints.csv

programs.name: sunszonecsv
programs.purpose: Compute and optionally apply near-surface travel-time shifts using a layered model in a Q-file.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUNSZONECSV - Near Surface Zone computations using a Q-file.
programs.float_sensitive_notes: The parameter inventory, library calls, selfdoc first line, and executable test cases have not been fully verified; ray-path calculations mix floating-point operations and square roots.
programs.difficulty_reason: It combines spatial model lookup, layered ray-path calculations, and trace interpolation.

programs.name: surandstat
programs.purpose: Apply a random integer sample shift to each seismic trace.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SURANDSTAT - Add RANDom time shifts STATIC errors to seismic traces

params.name: max
params.description: Maximum shift parameter; the cast occurs before multiplication, so typical seismic sampling intervals produce zero by default.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: The generator is reseeded with the same seed for every trace. The shift loop can access beyond the trace sample range, including tr.data[nt], and does not clear vacated samples.
programs.difficulty_reason: It applies a simple integer shift independently to each trace.
programs.license_note: Credits include U Houston: Chris Liner, circa 2009.

programs.name: surescsv
programs.purpose: Estimate surface-consistent residual source and receiver statics and write them as Q-files.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SURESCSV - Surface Consistent Residual Statics Determination.
programs.float_sensitive_notes: The parameter inventory, library calls, and executable test cases have not been fully verified. Iterative stack accumulation, correlation, peak interpolation, and sinc interpolation are sensitive to numerical ordering.
programs.difficulty_reason: It performs iterative surface-consistent statics estimation with buffered traces and spatial searches.

programs.name: suresstat
programs.purpose: Estimate surface-consistent source and receiver statics and write binary float files.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SURESSTAT - Surface consistent source and receiver statics calculation
programs.float_sensitive_notes: The parameter inventory, library calls, and executable test cases have not been fully verified. The estimator uses iterative stacking and correlation; stdin must support the random trace access used by gettra.
programs.difficulty_reason: It iteratively estimates shifts from multiple shot, receiver, and CMP gathers.

programs.name: sushiftcsv
programs.purpose: Apply source, receiver, and CDP shifts from Q-files to traces.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUSHIFTCSV - Shift traces using values from Q-files.
programs.float_sensitive_notes: The parameter inventory, library calls, selfdoc first line, and executable test cases have not been fully verified. Nearest-location searches and sinc interpolation are floating-point sensitive.
programs.difficulty_reason: It parses multiple Q-files, performs multidimensional nearest-location searches, and interpolates traces.

programs.name: sustatic
programs.purpose: Calculate or read static corrections and apply them to traces.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUSTATIC - Elevation STATIC corrections, apply corrections from
programs.float_sensitive_notes: The parameter inventory, library calls, selfdoc first line, and executable test cases have not been fully verified. Corrections use log10, pow, mixed precision, and sinc interpolation.
programs.difficulty_reason: It supports several correction sources and interpolates each trace.

programs.name: sustaticB

programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUSTATIC - Elevation STATIC corrections, apply corrections from
programs.float_sensitive_notes: The parameter inventory, library calls, selfdoc first line, and executable test cases have not been fully verified. Corrections use log10, pow, mixed precision, and sinc interpolation.
programs.difficulty_reason: It supports several correction sources and interpolates each trace.

programs.name: sustaticrrs
programs.purpose: Apply elevation or file-based statics and compute or apply residual refraction statics.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUSTATICRRS - Elevation STATIC corrections, apply corrections from
programs.float_sensitive_notes: The parameter inventory, library calls, and executable test cases have not been fully verified. Velocity integration, CMP accumulation, log10, pow, and sinc interpolation affect numerical reproducibility; several conditional parameters are read without checking whether they were supplied.
programs.difficulty_reason: It combines multiple statics modes with velocity-model integration and cross-run intermediate files.
programs.license_note: The file references Cox, Static corrections for seismic reflection surveys, Society of Exploration Geophysicists, 1999.
